product: Biochar + Dish Soap + Blackstrap Molasses Soil Detox Drench
rate: Biochar: 5-10 lb per 1,000 sq ft (dry, broadcast with a push spreader). Liquid mix per 3,000 sq ft batch: 16 oz (2 cups) blackstrap molasses dissolved in 16 oz warm water, plus 16 oz biodegradable dish soap; apply via hose-end sprayer set to 2 oz per gallon.
timing: Apply on an overcast day with a soaking rain forecast that evening, or manually flush with 75-100 gallons of water over 15-20 minutes if no rain is available. Broadcast dry biochar first, then spray the liquid mix directly on top. Let the treated soil rest 3-5 dry, warm days before seeding.
notes: Designed to remediate hydrophobic, chemically-sterilized sandy soil (e.g. after decades of synthetic lawn chemical service). The dish soap breaks water-repelling surface tension on sand grains; the biochar binds and locks up lingering herbicide/pesticide residues; the molasses sugar spikes native soil bacteria (lactic acid bacteria, Bacillus) which multiply and begin digesting the bound toxins. Apply dry biochar on a calm morning (it is very lightweight and will blow into pools/drains in wind) and lock it down with the liquid mix immediately. Avoid overwatering after the initial flush - let it sit and 'cook' before planting cover crop seed.
